text:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT: P0 - spike in 5xxs on edge-proxy (TLS handshake failures) – paging maya (eng-oncall)

maya (eng-oncall): seeing ~8% 5xx on /v1/generate from edge-proxy tier since 03:12 UTC. Alerts show 'SSL handshake error' and 'alert: tls: certificate has expired' in nginx logs. paging eng-sre + eng-runtime.

zach (eng-runtime): on it, joining. any recent cert rotations?

maya (eng-oncall): we rolled cert-rotator v2 last night to handle multi-tenant client certs. rotator job succeeded but I see errors when fetching private key from vault for tenant-legacy.

ops-bot: deploy-bot reports cert-rotator job logs: `ERROR: vault decrypt failed: KMS: access denied` at 02:58 UTC for tenant-legacy private key.

derek (eng-sre): quick check: access logs show repeated `SSL3_GET_CLIENT_HELLO: certificate verify failed` and `peer cert has expired` from a subset of clients -> looks like mTLS validation failing because the client cert expired (client cert expiry: 2026-03-09). This is client cert expiry, not server cert.

maya (eng-oncall): oh — tenant-legacy uses client cert pinning (mTLS). their client cert expired; edge is rejecting connections during TLS handshake which surfaces as 502/525 type errors upstream.

zach (eng-runtime): confirm: are these errors coming from internal service-to-service mTLS or external customer clients?

derek (eng-sre): external customers (third-party integrators) connecting to our edge. spike correlates to a handful of IPs belonging to tenant-legacy. overall traffic volume from them is small but the handshake failures trigger gateway fallback and amplify 5xx rate.

maya (eng-oncall): impact: global 5xx rate up from 0.7% -> 9% at peak. ~1200 requests/min failing currently from that tenant, causing downstream queue pressure and retries.

sarah (day-oncall): recommended mitigation options?

zach (eng-runtime): two quick mitigation paths: 1) Disable client cert verification at edge for that tenant (nginx) to allow traffic through while tenant rotates client certs. 2) Route tenant-legacy to a special gateway that accepts legacy certs / has client cert check relaxed. Option 1 is faster but reduces mTLS protection temporarily.

maya (eng-oncall): status page draft for customers?

derek (eng-sre): start with option 1 as hotfix. I'll prepare the nginx patch. maria, please confirm with security for temporary exception.

ops-bot: security notified: @security-team tagged for approval (auto).

--- live debugging logs ---

maya (eng-oncall): tail from edge-proxy at 03:18 UTC:
```
2026-03-11T03:18:21Z edge-proxy[nginx]: 10.10.50.22 - - [11/Mar/2026:03:18:21 +0000] "POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1" 502 0 "-" "client/1.2.3"
2026-03-11T03:18:21Z edge-proxy[nginx]: [error] 2324#0: *1423 SSL_do_handshake() failed (SSL: error:14094412:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert certificate expired) while SSL handshaking, client: 10.20.30.40, server: 0.0.0.0:443
```

zach (eng-runtime): reproduced locally with openssl s_client against the client's cert chain shows expiry:
```
$ openssl x509 -in client_cert.pem -noout -dates
notBefore=Feb 09 00:00:00 2025 GMT
notAfter=Mar 09 23:59:59 2026 GMT
```

maya (eng-oncall): emergency hotfix plan (commands below). I'll run it with derek and zach on standby.

1) Add temporary nginx map to skip client verification for tenant-legacy (fastest):
```
# /etc/nginx/conf.d/10-tenant-legacy-allow.conf
map $http_x_tenant_id $skip_client_verify {
  default 0;
  "tenant-legacy" 1;
}
server {
  listen 443 ssl;
  ssl_client_certificate /etc/ssl/ca_clients.pem;
  ssl_verify_client optional_no_ca; # keep optional to allow fallback
  if ($skip_client_verify = 1) {
    ssl_verify_client off;
  }
  ...
}
```

2) Reload nginx gracefully: `nginx -s reload` (test config first: `nginx -t`)

3) Notify tenant-legacy and ask for immediate client cert rotation. Provide them a one-hour maintenance window.

zach (eng-runtime): alternative safe route: create a new listener on 44301 without client verification and route tenant-legacy IPs there. That avoids touching global nginx config but needs fast routing rule.

maya (eng-oncall): running `nginx -t` now. will apply on success.

deploy-bot: config test OK on edge-proxy-01, edge-proxy-02. Proceed? (approve)

maya (eng-oncall): applying config on edge-proxy-01 -> reloaded. watching metrics.

10m later...

derek (eng-sre): after hotfix: 5xx rate for platform dropped from 9% -> 1.1%. tenant-legacy traffic now passing. No other tenants affected.

maya (eng-oncall): created a short post for status.redwood.ai: "We experienced elevated 5xx errors due to expired client certificate for a partner integration. We applied a temporary mitigation to accept legacy connections while the partner rotates their certificate. No data was exposed and mTLS verification will be reinstated after the partner rotates their cert. Root cause analysis in progress."

sarah (day-oncall): next steps / action items:
- derek: coordinate with security and determine exact exposure risk and get approval for the exception (due EOD).
- zach: implement a safer routing rule (listener on 44301) so we don't need per-tenant nginx if this happens again (due 48h).
- maya: confirm tenant-legacy rotated their client cert and re-enable client verification (watch metrics for 24h).
- eng-runtime: add alert to detect large upstream 5xx caused by TLS handshake errors specifically (tls_handshake_rate metric) (due 1 week).

derek (eng-sre): started RCA doc draft in /docs/incidents/rca-1776204000-client-cert-expiry.md (link internal)

maya (eng-oncall): handing off to day oncall @sarah. I will remain available if needed.

sarah (day-oncall): acknowledged, taking over.

pagerduty-bot: RESOLVED: Incident auto-closed at 04:20 UTC after error rate returned to baseline and tenant confirmed cert rotation.

--- notes / artifacts ---
- Affected endpoints: /v1/generate (edge-proxy TLS layer)
- Primary cause: expired client certificate used by partner (tenant-legacy) causing TLS handshake failures -> gateway 5xx and retry amplification.
- Hotfix: temporary disable client verification for tenant via nginx map.
- Risk: reduced mTLS guarantees for specific tenant during window. Security approved temporary exception.
- Follow-ups: routing rule for legacy tenants, alerting, improve rotator KMS error visibility, update onboarding docs for partner cert rotation reminders.

sarah (day-oncall): closing thread; dropping a pointer to the status page and RCA link once ready. :white_check_mark:
